what: training hyperparameters of the Python-4 study's Gemma-4 12B, Gemma-4 31B and GLM-4.5-Air 110B runs: midtraining, Dolci SFT, chat-vector graft, EFT (clean 0/256/1,024-row dose) and GRPO on the 31B graft (Run B-v2)
source: assembled 2026-09-15 from the as-run configs, run manifests, trainer constants and specs on jb/python4-campaign @ ae468044 (experiments/python4/*, src/scimt/train/*); each row's files below; ledgers experiments/python4/CAMPAIGN_STATUS.md and WEIGHTS_INDEX.md name the canonical runs

notes.text: Arms: control = Dolmino only; iso-token = the same 10.0M-token Python-4 corpus (four copies) at every scale; prop-token = a Python-4 dose proportional to parameter count, anchored at the whole 49.5M-token corpus for the 110B model (GLM run names: experimental = iso-token, experimental_50m = prop-token). Token counts are Gemma-3-tokenizer counts, the campaign's counting basis; the GLM step counts divide its own tokenizer's count of the same mixes (77.1M / 373.7M / 74.0M tokens) by 262,144.
Chat-vector grafts exist for all three scales; RL was run only on the Gemma-4 31B prop-token graft.

The campaign's matrix cells marked +EFT used a different, larger dose not shown in the paper's figures: 2,048 rows (1,843 Python-4 gold incl. held-out-rule problems + 205 canonical Dolci rows), 4 epochs = 256 steps, same LoRA recipe.

GRPO: the Run B-v2 step-0 EFT adapter was lost with its pod; the committed replicate (510 rows, 30 steps, fresh replay) is the step-0 model of the ladder figure. An earlier cold run on the same graft (run-4) differed in: no warm start, verbatim Boa diagnostics, a shaped reward, truncated completions masked out of the loss, 1,024 training problems, stopped at step 32.
